title: Work IQ: A2A and MCP tasks can ask for missing information or authorisation
summary: The briefing accurately distinguishes the planned elicitation capability from existing Work IQ behaviour and reports the differing Microsoft licensing and write-operation guidance. The controls and billing references support its actionable claims; two navigation paths stop early on the correct page and should be completed.
